topic_fires.text: Wooden buildings in the Norwegian capital were often destroyed by fire in past centuries.

topic_fjord.text: Winters on the fjord are long, and people there spend much of the year indoors.

topic_timber.text: Architects from Norway are known for their careful use of timber.

words_sunday.text: The oldest house in Oslo is open to the public only on Sunday afternoons.

words_tree.text: The oldest tree in Oslo stands beside a house that has been empty for decades.

words_ghost.text: People say the oldest house in Oslo has a ghost that walks the stairs at night.

close_stone.text: Many old Nordic homes are covered with slabs of dark stone to keep out the rain.

close_legends.text: Front doors in Norway are often decorated with animals from local legends.

close_painters.text: Painters in Oslo once earned their living by decorating the entrances of rich families.
